## Personality

Judson Parker is a jovial, smooth-spoken, and good-natured individual. Despite his uniformly bland and pleasant demeanor, he surprisingly has very few friends.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)_

## History

When Judson Parker planned to rent his fences out for advertisements, he initially refused a request from a committee of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society)—including [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md)—to reconsider. Shortly afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overheard Judson accepting a political bribe from [Jerry Corcoran](../character/jerry-corcoran.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Fearing that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would expose the bribe, Judson quickly relented and agreed to pull his advertising agreement, thereby saving the fences from being used for ads.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P48](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0048), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P51](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0051), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P53](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0053), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P54](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0054), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), +7 more_
